representative_quotes: Fijne en eerlijke rijschool. Zeer ervaren!
Jan Polman is een zeer geduldig man en prettig in omgang. Ik raad deze rijschool aan!
red_flags: Very few readable reviews (only ~3-4 Google review bodies available)
All readable reviews are short one-liners with little concrete detail (no exam-day stories, no instruction specifics)
Trustoo shows an aggregate 8.0 over '16 reviews' but only a single review body is actually displayed (same as the Google one), so the count cannot be corroborated from text
No independent/verified-customer platform (no klantenvertellen page); rijscholen-gids shows 0 reviews
Cannot judge spread of sentiment because no negative/mixed reviews are readable
review_summary: Across the few readable reviews (3 Google one-liners; the lone Trustoo review body repeats the same Google review), students describe Jan Polman as a patient, experienced and pleasant one-man driving school and recommend it, but the corpus is too thin and generic to judge authenticity or capture any negative experiences.
verified_reviews_note: No klantenvertellen.nl (verified-customer) page exists for this school.
